verdict.rationale: Warp documents several of its own retention controls. Users can keep sensitive Blocks from being saved locally or clear blocks from a machine entirely. Terminal input and output are claimed never to be stored on Warp servers. Business and Enterprise plans get a Zero Data Retention agreement covering AI interaction data, and team admins have centralized privacy controls. However, ZDR is plan-gated, and there is no documented user-facing way to set retention periods or delete server-side data such as cloud agent run transcripts, Warp Drive objects, or AI conversation history. missing for 10: configurable retention windows, user-initiated deletion of server-side data (account, conversations, run transcripts), ZDR on Free/Pro plans, independent corroboration.
